text: Microsecond-scale reputation updates defeat Sybil attacks by imposing an operational burden that makes maintaining multiple coherent identities across microsecond intervals computationally infeasible.
citation: Wulf A. Kaal, Cryptographic Foundations and Interdisciplinary Dimensions of the Secure Proof of Stake (SPoS) Conse (2025). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=5225296

isBasedOn.name: Cryptographic Foundations and Interdisciplinary Dimensions of the Secure Proof of Stake (SPoS) Conse

abstract: This temporal granularity imposes a significant operational burden on attackers, rendering it computationally infeasible to maintain multiple coherent identities across microsecond intervals

value: requires real-time behavioral signals such as block proposal frequency, vote consistency, and network latency
